scope: Configured GCP HML writers only. No global suspension claim. Explicit release required; no timed resumption.

controlVerification.note: IAM can accept an execution request, but the fixed /bin/false entrypoint and disabled identity prevent consumer execution; no Job was invoked for testing.

httpProbes.adminEvidence: unconditional proxy before authentication plus effective revision config; no real admin session used

requests.limitation: Request logs describe recorded requests; ingestion can lag and is combined with read-only DB/lease observations, not used alone to prove drain.

instanceMetrics.limitation: Sampled metrics with ingestion delay; not a live request counter.

limits: Job run/runWithOverrides IAM permissions were not revoked; requests can create failed execution records. Fixed /bin/false entrypoint prevents the consumer program from running, including args overrides. Consumer identity is additionally disabled. No execution requested.
Owner/deployer can undo configuration; operators must not change controls during window.
Disabled execution APIs were not enabled for listing. Disabled API is not evidence of absent historical resources; job/HTTP containment also covers calls from such triggers.
Admin maintenance proved by unconditional pre-auth guard in deployed source, effective config and 503 probes; no real admin session was used.
Vercel webhook was already interrupted before GCP mutations. Event recovery there requires Vinicius; no provider update or replay performed.
Database snapshots and sampled metrics/logs are bounded observations, not a database-wide exclusive lock; direct SQL and external writers remain separately coordinated.
